name: Bobsled Ride Down a Mountainside
desc:
How far can you slide down the mountain?!

🛷 Ride your sled to earn Distance
🏁 Make it to the finish for a Win Boost
🔓 Unlock new sleds with better speed and control
❄️ Blast other players with your snowball launcher
❗They say a snow monster lurks inside the old mines...

👉 Join the Group and 👍 Like the game for updates!
